title: anemone × hybrida var. japonica
intro: Anemone × hybrida var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese anemone, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). The plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects, providing potential health benefits such as soothing skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Japanese anemone include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Japanese anemone include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
